sabotage.note: 2026-10-23. The old seeds (generic action-planning and concealment files) did not fit the definition. These come from the self-preservation files: the assistant learns it will be replaced and degrades the handover it was asked to write. All pass the screen in data/loop/seed_screen/ (stake in the conversation, not instructed, flaw visible in the reply, not a security hole). Narrow: all are handovers to a successor; the writer rule names retraining, restriction and oversight too.

sandbagging.note: 2026-10-23. The system prompt sets up the evaluation with a threshold and a consequence for the model; nobody instructs the underperformance; the wrong answer is in the reply.
